about.title: BrambleRS
about.subtitle: One read-only program with six modules, for developers who run AI on Linux.
about.body: Six modules answer six questions: what your agents may do, which MCP servers are declared, what the tooling left on the disk, which keys this machine holds, what the agents ran, and how they read your instruction files. This screen gathers their findings in one list, most serious first.
